repair_handoff_quality.summary: Main handoff is narrow and actionable: align research-report-template.md with completion_check.sh, or update the hook to accept the current template structure; add deterministic fixture coverage and preserve bounded evidence wording.

core_findings.summary: Formal report template and completion hook disagree on heading level and exact section names, so template-following reports may fail the deterministic gate.
Evidence is explicitly bounded to static contracts and recorded evals; do not treat it as fresh blind empirical proof.
Triggering, adjacent routing, lightweight triage, and scenario coverage are strong.
